name: Mindmurk Oil

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-23: The Star-Crossed Court

text:
Activate 1 Interact

Often taken recreationally, mindmurk oil dulls the mind, creating a pleasant and euphoric stupor that inhibits the imbiber's decision-making skills and mental capacity.

---

Saving Throw DC 20 Fortitude save

Onset 30 minutes

Maximum Duration 1 hour

Stage 1 Stupefied 1 (5 minutes)

Stage 2 Stupefied 2 (5 minutes)

Stage 3 Stupefied 3 (5 minutes).
